name: AI Companion French
summary:
Speak French out loud with someone who always has time to talk - your own AI friend, 300 metres above the city.

CHOOSE YOUR FRIEND
Meet sixteen people - eight women and eight men - each with their own look, personality and voice. Point at someone to hear them say hello, and press the trigger to choose.

JUST TALK, IN FRENCH
